name: Hou Yi, Eclipse Walker — The Phoenix of the Fallen Arrows
description:
When the last sun collapsed, Hou Yi — once the divine archer — refused to fade. His body of bronze and flame turned to ash, and from that ash, wings of shadow grew. The bow of light he once wielded became his burden, forged now from the bones of the fallen suns.

He climbs through the darkness toward the echo of dawn, his claws gripping stone, his heart beating to the memory of fire. The world forgot his victories, yet his oath burns still — to strike the first light through the void, even if it devours him.

attributes.value: Athletic avian physique forged from ash and flame
Phoenix visage, golden eyes, predatory focus
Four clawed fingers each, pulling Solar Bow with tension
Minimal obsidian plates fused into body
Solar Bow made of phoenix bone and magma light
Single golden arrow glowing with dying sunlight
Climbing upward through darkness while drawing bow
Golden top light with ember underglow
Pure black void with faint upward radiance
